_about: The ONLY facts the receptionist may give. Invented for the fictional business (Kelmbridge, 'Brightwater Plumbing & Heating'); only the three safety entries carry real UK advice. 'answer' is spoken text, said word for word: numbers are written as words because the text goes straight to the text-to-speech voice. 'keywords' are lowercase words or phrases matched on word boundaries; a longer phrase scores more. 'safety' marks the entries used by the emergency fast path. 'fallback': true marks a generic entry (price questions such as 'how much does that cost?'): when the caller's question only hits a fallback entry, the sentence before it decides what 'that' is.

entries.answer: We're open Monday to Friday from eight in the morning until half past five, and on Saturdays from nine until one. For emergencies we're available twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.

keywords: how soon can you get here
entries.answer: For emergencies we aim to be with you within two hours, at any time of day or night. Out of hours, the call-out charge is ninety-five pounds, which includes the first hour. After that it's sixty-five pounds an hour.
We cover Kelmbridge and everywhere within fifteen miles of it, including Wexley Green, Harrowfield, Thornsby Cross and Overmere.
We do boiler repairs, servicing and replacements, central heating and radiators, taps, leaks and general plumbing, landlord gas safety certificates, and bathroom fitting.
We don't do electrical work, roofing, drain unblocking or gardening. For those you would need a different company.
A boiler service costs eighty-five pounds.
A landlord gas safety certificate costs seventy pounds.
We fit Worcester Bosch and Vaillant boilers, and we offer a free survey before we give you a price.
We fit new bathrooms. The quote is free, and we ask for a twenty-five percent deposit when you book the work.
Our rate is fifty-five pounds an hour during office hours, with a minimum charge of one hour.
Yes, our quotes are free.

entries.topic: How soon we can book a job
keywords: how long will it take to book
entries.answer: Jobs that aren't emergencies are usually booked in within three to five working days.
You can pay by card or by bank transfer.
All our work comes with a twelve-month labour guarantee.
Our engineers are Gas Safe registered, and we carry five million pounds of insurance.
You can cancel or change an appointment free of charge up to twenty-four hours before. After that there is a thirty pound cancellation fee.
Yes, we give priority to vulnerable customers, for example people who are elderly or ill and have no heating or hot water. Please tell us when you call.
You can reach us on oh one six three two, nine six oh, oh oh oh. Our email is hello at brightwater dash plumbing dot example, and our website is w w w dot brightwater dash plumbing dot example.

keywords: how long will it take for someone to call
entries.answer: In office hours, someone will call you back within two hours.
Our office is at Unit four, Mill Lane Trading Estate, Kelmbridge.

If you smell gas, open doors and windows if you can, don't use any flames or electrical switches, turn off the gas at the meter if it's safe to reach, and leave the property. Then call the National Gas Emergency number on oh eight hundred, one one one, nine nine nine. If anyone feels unwell, call nine nine nine.

If your carbon monoxide alarm sounds, or anyone has a headache, dizziness or feels sick, open doors and windows on your way out, get everyone into fresh air, and stop using the appliance. Then call the National Gas Emergency number on oh eight hundred, one one one, nine nine nine. If anyone is ill, call nine nine nine, and get medical advice even if the symptoms are mild.

entries.topic: Water leak or flood: what to do
entries.answer: If water is leaking, turn it off at the stopcock if you can reach it safely. If water is near electrics, switch the electricity off at the fuse box only if you can do it without standing in water, and keep away from wet sockets and appliances.
